item.title: Research Assistant Student Developer
item.description:
Overview:

Short-term research assistant position at the Faculty of Economics, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), focused on automating experimental data workflows.

Key contributions:

  • Implemented data workflows for image processing with the scope of automating work in relation to experiments conducted by the faculty.
